fieldValues.claim: AI may observe, extract, propose, question, organise, explain and coach. People decide, agree, ratify and remain accountable.
fieldValues.title: People decide, AI assists
fieldValues.explanation: In the SemanticOps stance, agents propose and people ratify. AI output is a proposal until a person accepts it. SRS gives agents tools to read and write records and does not enforce this as a tool rule: a repository enforces it through its own governance, or a client can apply a session write guard.
